newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade very slow in Kansas Tuesday. Few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady. Inquiry good, demand fair to moderate.
Sales confirmed on 600 slaughter steers and 800 slaughter heifers Tuesday.
For the week to date 11,600 head confirmed including 8,300 head previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter steers Select and Choice 2-3 1160-1240 lbs 71.00, load 1250 lb Holsteins 61.00.
Dressed basis Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lbs 117.00 hot weights, delivered.
Slaughter heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs 71.00.
